At public gatherings we are served refreshments.

We often choose our own refreshments.

What we need is nourishment.

For the body and the spirit or the soul.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

2 Aromas I remember, from growing up years.

Smell of tobacco burning and brewed 막걸리\^\[Makgeolli is a traditional Korean rice wine known for its milky, cloudy appearance, sweet and tangy flavor, and light fizziness. Made by fermenting rice, water, and nuruk (a fermentation starter), it's a low-alcohol drink (typically 6-15% ABV) that is served chilled and stirred before drinking to mix the settled sediment. <https://www.wikiwand.com/en/articles/Makgeolli>\]

I thought the smell of cigarette was good.

Not so much fermented rice wine.

The effects were immediate.

People seemed more relaxed and opened up.

The real impact is more substantial and in the distant.
